title: Lasagna
optional_add_ins: zucchini noodles (lengthwise, thin — sprinkle with salt, drain in colander)
steps: Cook meat, onion, and garlic in skillet. Stir in tomatoes, next 4 ingredients. Cover; simmer 15 min, stirring often. Cool noodles till tender in boiling salted water. Drain; rinse.
Beat eggs. Add ricotta, 1/2 cup parmesan, parsley, salt, and pepper. Combine.
Stuff 13x9x9 dish. Spread half meat sauce on bottom. Layer half noodles, all ricotta filling, half mozzarella. Add remaining sauce on top. Repeat layers.
Sprinkle remaining mozzarella and parmesan on top.
Bake covered at 375°F for 30–35 min. Bake uncovered for 45 min or until hot.
Pre-assembled and refrigerated: bake 45 min or until hot.
